verdict.rationale: Kintsugi lets you create multiple API keys, so an agent can get its own key that can be rotated without downtime, and keys can be set to expire after one month, six months, or one year. That gives time-bound, revocable agent credentials, but nothing in the evidence shows permission scopes, read-only keys, or limiting a key to particular endpoints or resources. Every request simply pairs an API key with an organization ID. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes, read-only or least-privilege key types, and resource- or endpoint-level restrictions for agent keys.
